3 /-! The four canonical graph forms in the six-vertex case without a universal vertex. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.SmallGraphs
6 
7 /-- Names for the four remaining original vertex-edge graphs. -/
8 inductive SixGraphKind where
9   | octahedron
10   | minusEdge
11   | prismDiagonal
12   | prism
13   deriving DecidableEq, Fintype
14 
15 /-- The complementary edges: three pairs, a four-vertex path and a pair, a six-vertex path, or a six-cycle. -/
16 def SixGraphKind.missingEdges : SixGraphKind → Finset (Sym2 (Fin 6))
17   | .octahedron => {s(0, 1), s(2, 3), s(4, 5)}
18   | .minusEdge => {s(0, 1), s(1, 2), s(2, 3), s(4, 5)}
19   | .prismDiagonal => {s(0, 1), s(1, 2), s(2, 3), s(3, 4), s(4, 5)}
20   | .prism => {s(0, 1), s(1, 2), s(2, 3), s(3, 4), s(4, 5), s(0, 5)}
21 
22 /-- A canonical type and a relabeling for each of the 45 permitted extra-edge patterns. -/
